Fama/French variable breakpoints

Source: R/data.r
breakpoints.Rd

Variable breakpoints time series. The variable breakpoints are used to construct the Fama/French portfolios and factors. Coverage starts in 1971: monthly breakpoints run from 197101 to 202609 and annual breakpoints from 1971 to 2026. Dividend/price breakpoints are observed in June only (197106 to 202606). The 1971 start is a maintainer decision (2026-11-14, spec #3 follow-up): R's lazyload database cannot serialise objects larger than 2^31 - 1 bytes, which the full-history bivariate exceeded; all series, `factors` included, start in 1971 (`variables` has no periods).

breakpoints

Format

A data.table with variables:

  • variable: Fama/French variable name. See the "variables" dataset in this package as well as https://mba.tuck.dartmouth.edu/pages/faculty/ken.french/Data_Library/variable_definitions.html for details. The "pior returns" label (prior returns) is kept as committed for compatibility.

  • frequency: variable observation frequency (month, year).

  • percentile: percentile breakpoint. "# negative" and "# positive" count the number of negative and positive occurrences for a given period respectively.

  • period: observation period.

  • value: corresponding variable breakpoint value.

Source

https://mba.tuck.dartmouth.edu/pages/faculty/ken.french/data_library.html.
